Other milk by-products include sugar of milk (lactose), condensed buttermilk, special formula skim milk products, lactalbumin, concentrated liquid skim milk and casein.
Other whole milk products includes malted milk, cream powder, formula milks, whole milk powder less than 26% fat, concentrated liquid milk and whole milk powder.
Concentrated partly skimmed milk of 2% is published separately beginning January 1981.
